x: But Sutton still had five in before our 5th man (Tom Carter 41st) and then praise be, Tommy Clinton came along in 57th place to complete our scoring six, while Sutton's 6th man finished 65th!

Africa; brother Alec has also been wounded but has returned to his unit---Arthur Beales is missing from air operations over Germany---Tommy Clinton (Irish Guards) writes from hospital that he was wounded just before last Christmas whilst on a landing trip.
Alongside Tom's name in the entry list were those of J. Smart, T.
